purpose: Illustrated homepage revision: believable rectangular startup office with Flap branding, replacing fantasy butterfly architecture.

parameters.prompt:
Edit the supplied FLAP COMPANY illustrated desktop website concept. The user LIKES the cartoon art style, eight recognizable characters, purple/lime branding and overall website UI, but wants a more believable NORMAL OFFICE. Preserve the illustration medium and character identities. "Real office" means plausible everyday architecture and workplace organization, NOT photorealistic rendering.

MAIN CHANGE: replace the fantastical butterfly-shaped building, sculptural curved pods, giant central lime tower, rooftop/campus fantasy, moon and magical skyline with a genuinely believable beautifully illustrated startup office. A spacious ordinary rectangular open-plan office shown from a slightly elevated three-quarter cutaway perspective, coherent floor plan, straight walls and a normal single-level ceiling cut away to reveal the interior. No strange building silhouette. No tower. No giant freestanding monument. No literal butterfly architecture. It must look like somewhere a small creative team could actually work.

OFFICE CONTENT: broad rectangular floor in warm pale wood with muted purple rugs; two sensible rows of desks with computers, monitors, notebooks and coffee mugs; a glass-partition meeting room in the rear with straight frames, a table and chairs; whiteboards with a few sketches; bookshelves and low storage; leafy potted plants; hanging practical pendant lamps; small coffee nook; large regular rectangular windows overlooking a quiet softly drawn city. Clear walking aisles, plausible furniture scale, ample uncluttered space. One floor, no mezzanine or tiered butterfly wings. Warm inviting office atmosphere, afternoon-to-evening window light. Desk lamps glow gently but no neon cyberpunk architecture. The office is impressive because of beautiful illustration, charming characters and thoughtful detail.

BRANDING: a tasteful normal-sized FLAP COMPANY wall sign in the office reception/back wall; small purple butterfly decals on laptops or a wall; a few violet upholstery choices and lime accessories; one restrained framed Flap poster. No giant slogan everywhere, no repeating motivational text on every wall. Violet #5533FF and lime #DAFF00 serve as environmental accents. Warm wood, lavender walls, cream paper, black furniture outlines are allowed to make it feel lived-in and real. Surrounding website background remains deep plum, with a subtle illustrated interior wall treatment; remove fantasy night clouds, sparkling cosmic particles, large moon, flying butterflies, river, bridge and decorative city panorama outside the office.

PRESERVE THE EIGHT DISTINCTIVE EMPLOYEES from the supplied image, each ONCE inside the office, large enough to recognize:
Cedric the icy-blue mountain-headed character at meeting table; Carol the pink character with pastel-blue mushroom hair at a laptop; Jason the orange animal-hooded black-faced character with small propeller reviewing papers; Irene the pink iridescent slime-hood character holding tablet; Madaks the masked black cat-hoodie character by the community whiteboard; Toko the dark hedgehog toy with red scarf and wind-up key sketching; Duan the orange bull-hood character with cream horns working at a monitor; Shinny the golden halo/hood character editing a document. Preserve their head silhouettes, expressions, colors, original 2D cartoon faces, big heads and small bodies. Do not add ordinary human employees. Scene drawn with confident dark outlines, flat color masses, two or three cel-shaded values and subtle painted accents, matching the input. NO plastic 3D figures, NO realistic humans, NO photorealism.

KEEP THE FRONTEND COMPOSITION from the reference, adjusting only small spacing to fit the new workplace scene: compact top navigation with FLAP COMPANY logo, Office, Agents, Projects, Company Logs; small OFFICE PREVIEW at upper right. Large left headline 'Eight minds.' / 'One company.' and supporting copy 'Autonomous research, ideas and experiments for the Flap ecosystem.' with 'Explore the company ↗'. Main office illustration dominates center, approximately x=26% to 79%, y=14% to 83%. Do not overlap headline or right activity panel. Right deep-purple panel 'FROM THE OFFICE' with the same Jason, Carol and Cedric messages, portraits and times. Bottom single information dock with THE TEAM / 8 AGENTS, eight matching named profile avatars, ACTIVE PROJECT / Custom Quote Explainer / Carol · Drafting, LATEST COMPANY LOG / Research before the narrative. / Read the log ↗, and small illustrated folder/booklet. Preserve sharp, readable English interface copy, same professional sans-serif typography, warm-white foreground, dark purple panels and lime accents. Keep the functional UI sleek; only the scene is cartoon. Preserve wide 16:9 screenshot format. Deliver one refined finished website design comp. No browser chrome, no mockup device, no concept labels or explanations.
